name: Feature Halos
definition: A technique to create halo effects in planes orthogonal to the view vector by making regions just outside features darker and more opaque, obscuring background elements to reinforce depth perception.
summary: Feature Halos is a non-photorealistic volume rendering technique that enhances depth perception by darkening and increasing opacity near volumetric features, distinguishing itself by generating these effects directly during the illumination pass using local spatial properties.
